reviewer: gendn editorial upgrade & live-source audit (checked 2026-11-27 against ChromeStatus 6046077976444928, webstatus.dev local-network-access, and live MDN)

rubric.evidence: Re-verified 2026-11-27 against ChromeStatus API 6046077976444928 (stage 160 desktop_first: 151, top-level status still 'Proposed', accurate_as_of 2026-06-22, Firefox and Safari No signal) and WICG Direct Sockets / Private Network Access drafts. Preserves the ChromeStatus status divergence note transparently.
Correctly filed under v151 with immutable ChromeStatus identity 6046077976444928 and desktop-only Isolated Web Apps scope.

Live MDN check on 2026-11-27 confirmed MDN publishes Permissions-Policy/local-network and Permissions-Policy/loopback-network for general Local Network Access (HTTP 200), but neither page mentions Direct Sockets, IWA manifests, or direct-sockets-private, justifying local retention. All five reference-contract.json anchor selectors (#at-a-glance, #why-it-exists, #syntax, #examples, #browser-compatibility) are preserved.

Clearly explains least-privilege separation between RFC 1918 LAN access (local-network) and localhost daemon access (loopback-network), deprecation of direct-sockets-private, and TCPSocket/UDPSocket rejection behavior when policies are omitted.

Provides clear IWA manifest permissions_policy snippets in <pre tabindex='0'><code> annotated with explicit data-doc-test='skip' reasons (verified with 0 failures/warnings by scripts/doc-tests.mjs); minor deduction because the comparison block uses JS-style // comments inside JSON rather than two separate strict JSON manifest blocks.

Baseline banner and Browser support table accurately state desktop IWA-only Chromium 151+ availability, clarify distinction from webstatus.dev's general local-network-access entry, and record Firefox/Safari No signal.

Every source and citation label links directly to its primary artifact with target='_blank' rel='noopener' (ChromeStatus 6046077976444928, WICG Direct Sockets, WICG IWA, W3C Permissions Policy, WICG PNA, MDN Permissions-Policy/local-network/loopback-network, webstatus.dev); zero legacy-host URLs.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2 outline, role='note' Baseline banner, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <thead>/<tbody> and <th scope='col|row'> in keyboard-focusable .table-wrap regions, and <pre tabindex='0'> code blocks.

Upgraded to modern editorial shell (/public/styles.css + /public/favicon.svg) with logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap, focus-visible ring, and horizontal table containment verified with zero overflow on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (360x740).
Preserves exact route-bindings.json demo: null (requires an installed Isolated Web App with signed manifest and Direct Sockets permissions) without modifying immutable conformance.json.
